title: Entity pulls him out of his body and scolds him out of depression
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Entity pulls him out of his body and scolds him out of depression, about c. 1970 at Germany, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: night um I'm asleep and I was awake in the middle Night by an entity that snatched me out of my body

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that around 1970, while he was in Germany and sunk in depression, he was woken in the middle of the night by an entity that pulled him right out of his body. He says the being scolded him and snapped him out of his low state. He tells it as a turning point that shaped his life afterward.
